initial.title: Spider beside a Teapot
initial.composition: A friendly brown spider stands next to a tiny teal teapot and one cup, eight legs spread around its visible body.
initial.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original polished professional clipart for imaginative tea party stories. A friendly brown spider stands next to a tiny teal teapot and one cup, eight legs spread around its visible body. Thoughtful fresh composition. The spider is a complete body with TWO main segments and exactly EIGHT articulated walking legs, four matching pairs: four left and four right, every leg separately traceable from its attachment to tip. Interaction leg counts among those eight; never add human arms. Slight overhead angle for clear leg visibility. Round expressive face, charming natural asymmetric pose. Smooth carefully layered cel shading, warm handcrafted children's book finish, confident clean ink outlines, medium broad fur tufts only, no micrograin. Main prop sits beside body not hiding legs. Whole artwork inside central70% canvas, ample clear margin. Genuine transparent background and all gaps transparent. No white fringe, colored halo, words, labels, watermark or cast shadow.
